top_news.title: PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems
top_news.dek: PsyBer-Agent introduces a psychology-inspired engine to simulate long-term user dynamics like fatigue and shifting preferences in recommender systems.
top_news.brief: Current LLM-based simulators often fail to capture realistic user behavior over extended interaction cycles. PsyBer-Agent addresses this by modeling latent states—such as affect and fatigue—to better align simulated trajectories with real-world interaction logs.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the Psy-Engine architecture with evolving latent user states.

top_news.title: Google Antigravity SDK Adds Local Model Support for Greater Token Efficiency and Code Privacy
top_news.dek: Google's Antigravity SDK now supports local model execution, allowing developers to balance cloud-based tasks with private, low-latency local inference.
top_news.brief: The update enables agentic workflows to run directly on local hardware, providing developers with improved data privacy, reduced network dependencies, and better control over inference costs. Users can mix local and cloud models based on specific workload requirements.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual graphic showing a hybrid cloud and local model architecture.

top_news.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
top_news.dek: Google DeepMind and Singapore's GovTech are deploying on-device Gemma models to detect conversational scams in real-time without cloud data egress.
top_news.brief: This collaboration utilizes lightweight, fine-tuned Gemma models to identify fraudulent patterns directly on user devices. By keeping data local, the system provides privacy-preserving protection against scams in private messaging environments.
top_news.image_alt: Illustration of on-device AI processing protecting a mobile messaging interface.

top_news.title: llm-gemini 0.35
top_news.dek: The llm-gemini CLI tool has been updated to version 0.35, adding support for the new Gemini 4 Argon model.
top_news.brief: The update integrates Gemini 4 Argon into the popular llm command-line interface. This allows developers to access the latest model capabilities directly from their terminal, including improved SVG generation performance.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal window showing the llm CLI tool interface.

top_news.title: Show HN: Parsimony – an open-source benchmark for how much code AI models add
top_news.dek: Parsimony is a new open-source benchmark that evaluates AI coding agents based on the net volume of code added rather than just solve rates.
top_news.brief: Unlike traditional benchmarks that focus on success, Parsimony measures 'coding units' to penalize excessive or bloated code generation. It calculates net units by subtracting removed code from added code, helping developers identify models that produce cleaner, more maintainable solutions.
top_news.image_alt: Chart comparing AI model performance based on net coding units added.
